_comment: Playwright specs that exist under e2e/ but are NOT run by any GitHub workflow. PR CI smoke is e2e/core-pages.spec.ts only (ci.yml e2e-web) — these suites are local/manual (some have package.json scripts). Listing here is an explicit non-CI declaration, not a runner. scripts/check-e2e-runner.ts fails if a spec is in neither a workflow nor this list. Do not add a spec to PR CI just to get it off this list unless the budget already exists.
